headlines.text: Flash back to 2023, when Jon Moxley vs. Kenny Omega fought it out in a Steel Cage match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 8.78 ? a genuine showstealer. Moxley and Omega tore each other apart in a bloody steel cage brawl using barbed wire and broken glass, but Don Callis' own screwdriver shot to Omega's head cost his ally the match right after he'd hit a One Winged Angel.
On this day in 2023, Claudio Castagnoli vs. Rey Fenix met in a Double Jeopardy Match, opening the card on Dynamite, rated 7.94 ? a match that delivered.

Back on this day in 2023, House of Black vs. Best Friends & Bandido clashed for the AEW World Trios Titles in an Open House match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.48. It was the first title opportunity of Best Friends & Bandido's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: On a Wednesday in 2023, back when Orange Cassidy vs. Daniel Garcia fought tooth and nail for the AEW International Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.59 ? a strong outing.
